answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with random walks capped at \(T\) steps from honest seeds. If a sybil set \(S\) has conductance \(\phi(S)=w(S,\bar S)/\mathrm{vol}(S)\) and its external cut carries at most \(\epsilon\) of the walk’s outgoing mass per step, the probability—and hence walk-weighted voting mass—entering \(S\) is at most \(T\epsilon\). A copper reef of colluding accounts may amplify a ripple internally, but cannot exceed this cut-limited bound absent trusted entry points.
